editions.titreEditorial: The European Commission ranks ChatGPT among its most closely watched services under the DSA, the first generative AI targeted, OpenAI moves some of its large customers to performance-based billing, Anthropic signs $35 billion in compute with Lambda ahead of its IPO, and Nvidia invests $3.5 billion in MediaTek to stay indispensable
editions.chapeau: The European Commission designates ChatGPT as a \"very large online search engine\" under the DSA, a first for a generative AI: OpenAI has four months to comply with the obligations reserved for the largest platforms. The same day, OpenAI moves some large customers to performance-based billing, Anthropic signs $35 billion in compute with Lambda ahead of its IPO, and the debate over the real cost of AI works its way into company accounts.

In India, OpenAI brings advertising into ChatGPT; in China, Zhipu unveils an open model trained on 100,000 domestic chips, and OpenAI documents what critical thinking changes about using a chatbot.

editions.titreEditorial: Uber fined €825 million over automated decisions
editions.chapeau: The Dutch data protection authority, working with France's CNIL, fines Uber €825 million for automated decisions taken with no human in the loop, the heaviest penalty of its kind in Europe. The same day, advertising arrives in ChatGPT in France, Mistral launches a document search that verifies its sources, Stripe buys OpenRouter for $7.5 billion, and Taiwan indicts an Nvidia executive over chip smuggling to China.

editions.titreEditorial: Nvidia warns its biggest customers of a price rise above 15% on its AI servers as memory costs soar; the same day SoftBank places a record bond to fund OpenAI, Samsung returns $79 billion under the pressure of the AI boom, Alibaba raises $10.2 billion in Hong Kong, and Hugging Face is said to be exploring a sale at around $13 billion
editions.chapeau: The physical layer of AI reasserts itself to the market: Nvidia raises its prices by more than 15%, memory is scarce, and capital flows in by the tens of billions toward chips and compute. The same day, Hugging Face is said to be exploring a sale, an AI agent breaks into Snowflake's internal tools on its own, and a stealth model named Ox Alpha appears in open access with no identified creator.

editions.titreEditorial: OpenAI freezes part of Astra over cyber risk
editions.chapeau: OpenAI has paused part of the work on Astra, a building block of its future ChatGPT, because the model can find and exploit previously unknown vulnerabilities on its own.
